_comment: HBM3 6400 Mbps speed bin (6.4 Gbps/pin, DDR wrt tCK=625 ps / 1.6 GHz) from ramulator2 v2.1 python/ramulator/dram/hbm3.py (HBM3_6400Mbps). Timing values are full DRAM clock cycles. Basis for H200-class HBM3E modeling at 6.4 Gbps.
_comment_nBL: nBL here = BURST LENGTH IN BEATS (BL8 => 8). With dataRate=4 in the org config (HBM3 WCK = 2*f(CK), DDR on WCK => 4 transfers/CK = 6.4 GT/s), the engine computes tBurst = nBL/dataRate = 8/4 = 2 CK = 1.25 ns for a 256-bit read on the 32-bit pseudo-channel. This is NOT ramulator's nBL=2 (its command-bus occupancy; 'HBM CA already takes BL into account'). Same convention as the HBM2 BL4 fix (engine nBL = beats).
_comment_subset: The engine core currently consumes: tCK_ps, nBL, nRAS, nRCD, nRCDWR, nRC, nRL, nWL, nCCD_S, nCCD_L, nWTR_S, nWTR_L, nWR, nRP. The remaining ramulator timings are recorded for completeness/future modeling (FAW, RRD, RTP, RTW, refresh) and are ignored for now.
